item: Ratchet: every requirements.lock pin satisfies every pyproject range, and every core requirement is pinned
summary: requirements.lock is the hash-verified clean-room install, so a pin outside a range pyproject.toml declares was caught only for urllib3, trafilatura and starlette, each by a hand-written test written after that package had drifted. tests/test_lock_satisfies_pyproject.py checks every requirement of [project].dependencies and of every extra whose package the lock pins (39 of today's 60, all satisfied; the other 21 sit in extras the lock is not generated for), asserts every core requirement IS pinned (the first check passes vacuously for a package the lock lacks), and that no package is pinned twice. It reads pins written with extras (lxml[html-clean], uvicorn[standard]) and never asks for a newer pin. Red without: nine mutants (parser without the extras group, pin below a floor, above a ceiling, a core pin removed, a duplicate pin, pre-releases refused, unpinned core ignored, duplicates ignored, no pins parsed) each fail a named test.
